What are you doing?

How to read this atlas

  • Each map summarizes regions implicated in group-level neuroimaging literature. It is not an individual brain scan.
  • Color identifies anatomical regions. It does not encode stronger or weaker activation.
  • “Activation” means a difference between a task and a study-specific comparison condition. Changing that contrast can change the map.
  • fMRI BOLD is an indirect vascular correlate of neural activity. Study populations, scanners, preprocessing, and tasks vary.
  • Deep structures are approximate surface projections on this external brain model. This atlas is educational, not diagnostic.
